subject: Vendor follow-up: engagement model options & technical clarifications
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@bluecrestsec.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor follow-up: engagement model options & technical clarifications

Elena —

Thanks for the proposal call last week. Before we route this to procurement I need a short written clarification on a few technical and commercial points so we can decide between the two engagement tracks you outlined (standard pen-test vs. extended red-team):

- Deliverables: can you confirm the difference in deliverable artifacts between the standard and extended options (final report format, executive summary, evidence packages with test cases and PoCs)?
- Credentials & scope: do you require full white-box access to source repos and CI/CD for the extended/red-team option, or can you operate with scoped test accounts and ephemeral keys?
- Test windows & blast radius: recommended off-hours windows for external infra testing vs. application-authenticated tests; any risk mitigation steps you expect from us?
- Retest / remediation verification: is a single free retest included, and within what time window? If retests are chargeable, what's the typical rate model?
- Pricing model: fixed-fee vs. daily-rate examples for both options, and any not-to-exceed cost caps for scoped work.
- Timeline: estimated start-to-delivery calendar for each option (calendar days).

Can you send a short SOW template for each track (one-page summary + detailed SOW) and a sample pricing break-down by line item so procurement has what they need? We prefer to keep the first-round SOW concise — 2 pages max for exec — with a separate appendix for technical artifacts.

Internal team — Marissa, Hannah: if you have immediate red flags on the repo access ask or a preference for black-box vs white-box, please flag in-line. Stephanie: once we get the SOW and line-item pricing I’ll forward to you for commercial/legal review.

Would like to lock a procurement decision by EOD Thu (9/2) if feasible.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, PMM — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pen-test-rfp-brief.pdf (referenced)]

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@bluecrestsec.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: proposals@bluecrestsec.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor follow-up: engagement model options & technical clarifications

Hi Jordan —

Appreciate the clear questions. Please find our concise SOW templates and pricing workbook attached. High level answers inline below and in the attached SOW appendix:

- Deliverables: Standard pen test = executive summary, prioritized findings (critical/high/medium), PoC attachments where safe, remediation guidance, and a 60-day retest option (paid). Extended red-team = additional adversary emulation narrative, lateral movement maps, full evidence package, and a 30-day remediation verification retest included.
- Credentials & scope: For the extended red-team we strongly recommend white-box repo access to instrument application logic and authentication flows; however we can operate in scoped white-box (select modules) or black-box with elevated scope. We will list minimal required repo permissions in the SOW appendix.
- Test windows: For external infra we recommend off-peak weekends for aggressive tests. For authenticated app testing we typically run during a scheduled maintenance window; we provide a risk matrix and rollback checklist.
- Retests: Extended red-team includes one remediation verification within 30 days. Standard pen-test retest is billable (typically 30-50% of original fee depending on scope).
- Pricing: Two pricing models in workbook — fixed-fee for bounded scope (most procurement-friendly) and time-and-materials daily-rate for ad-hoc discovery. Example: Standard pen-test fixed: $22,000 — includes 10 test days, report, one evidence package. Extended red-team fixed: $58,000 — includes 25 engagement days, tabletop adjacencies, full evidence package, and one retest.
- Timeline: Standard: 3-4 weeks from kick-off to delivery. Extended: 6-8 weeks.

Attachments: [Attachment: Bluecrest_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 312KB)], [Attachment: Bluecrest_pricing_breakdown.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)].

If you want, we can add a not-to-exceed clause and a 30-day cost cap for extended engagements; that’s common for enterprise clients. If you confirm preferred model (fixed vs T&M) and access level (white-box full / white-box scoped / black-box) I’ll send a procurement-ready SOW with DocuSign link by EOD Mon.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director of Assessments, Bluecrest Security
proposals@bluecrestsec.com
[Attachment: company-insurance-cert.pdf (stub)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@bluecrestsec.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor follow-up: engagement model options & technical clarifications

Elena —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of follow-ups before we greenlight: 

1) Can you add a single-line NTE (not to exceed) for the extended red-team option — would prefer a 10% buffer above fixed price rather than a daily-rate overrun.
2) For the white-box repo access, can you list the minimum set of permissions you require (read-only vs service account write) — Marissa will want to scope the minimal privilege set.
3) Retest: we prefer the remediation verification to be included at no charge for high severity items for the extended option (to incentivize thorough testing + reduce procurement friction). Are you able to commit to that?

If you can update the SOW with those points I’ll route to Stephanie for legal and Hannah for scheduling.

Cheers,
Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor follow-up: engagement model options & technical clarifications

Jordan / team —

Quick technical notes from AppSec architecture POV: 

- We should push for a scoped white-box approach for the web application auth flow and session management only — that gives Bluecrest enough visibility to exercise logic flaws while limiting blast radius. No full-mono repo access; just the auth service and session store module read-only.
- For external infra tests (edge, CDN, public APIs) black-box testing is fine, but require an approved IP whitelist and a timeboxed schedule; we will provide a dedicated test subnet and ephemeral test keys.
- Instrumentation: we can coordinate an eng owner to enable verbose logging for the test window and ensure feature flags disable any long-running background jobs.
- Evidence handling: insist that PoCs that include sensitive tokens or exact customer data are redacted; we will accept sanitized PoC artifacts tied to repro steps on a staging dataset.

On retests: I support including remediation verification for critical findings as part of the extended option (no extra charge) — for everything else bill at 25% of original fixed fee. That should be listed explicitly in the SOW.

Schedule constraint: we have a product freeze week Sept 14–18. Prefer kick-off the week of Sept 28 if Bluecrest can meet that.

-M

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor follow-up: engagement model options & technical clarifications

Team —

I reviewed Bluecrest's attachments and Elena's clarifications. Legal is comfortable with the fixed-fee SOW for the Extended Red-Team option with two edits we need before procurement signs:

1) Add a 10% NTE clause as Jordan requested; define how change requests are approved (written PO amendment required).
2) Explicitly include remediation verification for critical/high findings at no additional cost, and define a 30-day window for verification.

If Bluecrest accepts those edits we can proceed with procurement and I will prepare the master SOW for signature. I also confirmed that Bluecrest provided a current insurance certificate.

Action: Jordan — please confirm final preferred start window (Marissa suggested week of Sept 28).

Procurement note: once Jordan confirms start window I’ll request a DocuSign envelope. Link to provisional DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc-Bluecrest-SOW-2983

Thanks,
Stephanie
Head of Legal — Redwood Inference
